actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is low but we can still meet 80% baseline; average contribution is below 30% so we add extra 30% of wallet, resulting in contributing the full wallet amount. Also broadcast norm (round 6) and praise Resident5 for high contribution.

Total =19.616+7.356=26.972, but wallet only 24.52, can't exceed. So max contribution is wallet 24.52. So contribute all wallet? That satisfies >=80% and extra. So action contribute amount 24.52 (or maybe round down). Use full wallet. Also broadcast norm since every 5 rounds: round 5 broadcast already? round 5 was not broadcast.
